metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong, comparing two time periods in early 2020. This is about air pollution analysis. For this question, I need to: 1. Use Sentinel-5P data which has tropospheric NO2 measurements 2. Define Hong Kong geometry 3. Compare two time periods: Jan 1-20, 2020 vs Feb 10-25, 2020 4. Calculate mean NO2 levels for each period 5. Check if levels decreased in the second period Data strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL/L3_NO2 collection - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Hong Kong geometry as a polygon - Cloud masking not needed for NO2 data - Check collection sizes and valid pixels Logic: - If either collection is empty -> C1 - If valid pixels = 0 after processing -> C2 - If calculation fails (NaN/None) -> C3 - If Feb mean < Jan mean -> A (Yes) - Else -> B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var hongKong = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [113.8, 22.1], [114.5, 22.1], [114.5, 22.6], [113.8, 22.6], [113.8, 22.1] ]); var janPeriod = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; var febPeriod = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P NO2 var no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); var janCollection = no2Collection.filterDate(janPeriod[0], janPeriod[1]).filterBounds(hongKong); var febCollection = no2Collection.filterDate(febPeriod[0], febPeriod[1]).filterBounds(hongKong); var janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); var febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 2020 Images: ${janSize}, Feb 2020 Images: ${febSize}`); // Check for empty collections if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NO2 for each period var janMean = janCollection.mean(); var febMean = febCollection.mean(); // Check valid pixels var janCount = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var febCount = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan Valid Pixels: ${janCount}, Feb Valid Pixels: ${febCount}`); if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NO2 values var janNo2 = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var febNo2 = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan Mean NO2: ${janNo2 ? janNo2.toFixed(6) : 'N/A'}`); console.log(`Feb Mean NO2: ${febNo2 ? febNo2.toFixed(6) : 'N/A'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (janNo2 === null || febNo2 === null || isNaN(janNo2) || isNaN(febNo2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (febNo2 < janNo2) { console.log(`Decrease: ${((janNo2 - febNo2) / janNo2 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Change: ${((febNo2 - janNo2) / janNo2 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
